paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Polarity scores for Indonesia
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the distribution of counts of vaccine-related sentiments in Indonesia, categorized by their polarity scores. The x-axis, labeled “Polarity scores,” ranges from -1.0 to 0.6 and is linearly scaled, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled “Counts,” ranges from 0 to 35,000 and is also linearly scaled, with tick marks at intervals of 5,000. A single blue line, marked with blue circular data points and connected by solid lines, represents the count distribution. The line begins at a count of 0 when the polarity score is -1.0, remains nearly flat at low counts until approximately -0.6, then gradually increases to a peak of 35,000 at a polarity score of 0.0. Following this peak, the line sharply declines to approximately 12,000 at a polarity score of 0.2, then continues to decrease to a minimum of 0 at a polarity score of 0.4 before rising slightly to approximately 6,000 at 0.5 and falling again to 0 at 0.6.
